narrative.intro: Bechtel National shows $73M in federal contract obligations for FY27 to date. Bechtel National recorded a single obligation, so the average award size is $73M. Obligations fell 93.9% year over year. Historical obligations show larger activity in prior fiscal years: FY22 obligations were $1.2B, FY23 obligations were $1.4B, FY24 obligations were $983M, FY25 obligations were $1.1B, and FY26 obligations were $1.2B. The current-year total is partial and represents fiscal year to date obligations. The contrast between the FY27 to date total and prior full-year totals highlights a sharp pullback in obligations so far this fiscal year. Contractors and partners should treat FY27 numbers as incomplete until the fiscal year closes, because award count and total obligations can change as agencies issue additional awards later in the year.
